name: salesforce-privilege-lab
description: Salesforce Privilege LAB: connect a Salesforce Developer org to PingOne Privilege, then grant and revoke a permission set for a time window. A mock Salesforce org and a mock Privilege app on a lab clock, with the setup knowledge that went wrong and why. Mock by default; an owner-run, read-only Real read. No tenant, no outbound network in Mock.

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
